contracts.name: parseThenScale
contracts.signature: function parseThenScale(text: string, fallback: number, factor: number): number

preconditions: Text arguments contain at most 64 Unicode code points each and no lone surrogate code units. Indices and lengths count code points, not UTF-16 units. Inputs are unchanged; returned arrays are fresh. Text has at most 20 characters, any accepted value is finite and between -1000 and 1000, and numeric arguments are between -1000 and 1000.
